_about: Days, Decide questions and the items the game master can send. Edit and save: the server reloads it. 'run' is each day's run sheet in order: a step starts a phase, sends an item, records a decision, or is a cue the game master just ticks off. {'decision': true} records the day's first question. {'decision': 'key', 'q', 'opts'} is an outcome only the game master sees, kept under that key. 'by' + 'versions' on a cue name the film to play for an earlier decision; 'also' adds more parts to the name; 'when' shows a step or a question only for that decision. Items not in 'run' sit under More. Teams and minutes here are only the starting point; the game master changes them live on the Setup tab (kept in state.json). Item types: statement | post | thread | note. 'to' is a team id or a role id; leave it out for everyone. SOURCES (2026-11-21): names, facts and film numbers follow the reads as shot on 19 Nov (vault sources/2026-11-19-geeta-shoot-as-read.md) and the review export 'v3 review 2026-11-20'. Posts and leaks are copied from data/social.json; those marked 'draft': true are wording the script only describes, awaiting Jay's approval. The Decide questions are carried over from the 17 Nov version with the names changed. The two outcome steps on Friday and the choice-to-ending map are a reading of the films: confirm before the day. BACKGROUND BOARD: 'board' is each day's figures and lines beside the clock, shown when the run reaches a {'board': n} step (n is the stage: 1 morning, 2 afternoon; a later row with the same 'k' replaces the earlier one). A row is a figure ('value' + 'label') or a line ('text'); 'to' limits it to one table; 'by' + 'versions' pick the value or text for an earlier decision; 'when' shows it only for that decision. 'ticker' is the day's made-up share prices along the bottom. Rows marked 'invented': true are not in the scripts or films and await Jay's approval; the rest are figures Geeta reads or that appear in the film graphics. 'logo' on an item names a folder in public/orgs (copied from brand/orgs): posts use its avatar, statements its lockup, leaks its avatar in the header. 'brief' is each table's private figures, shown as one card at the top of that table's briefing column from the day's first board step: 'to' is the table, the rest works like a board row. Every 'brief' row and the board lines marked 'invented' are made up (table/FIGURES-DRAFT.md), approved in bulk by Jay on 2026-11-21.
